svg.title: Spectra maintenance: separate update and doctor paths with preservation boundaries
svg.desc: Update checks an installed or recognized legacy project and refreshes only when needed and confirmed; a newer CLI can change the installation outside the project. Doctor reports health without writes; doctor --fix refreshes generated project assets and repairs missing adapters only when safe. Preserved information is a boundary, not a subsequent action. Explicit adapter regeneration is a separate user command. Groups M1 to M4 have matching HTML explanations.

div.style: color: rgb(81, 67, 198) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
